notes: The first route («ح») ends at «ابن جريج»; the names after him are written once, after the last «ح», and form the shared tail (rule 3)
«رجل، من أهل العراق يقال له شقيق بن سلمة أبو وائل» is one link: the unnamed «رجل» is then named (rule 8)

«أن رجلا من بني تغلب يقال له الصبى بن معبد» is the story's subject, who also speaks («فقال الصبى») and relays Umar's words: whether he is a link cannot be settled (rule 6), so he and Umar are not added
«- يعني ابن إسحاق -» is a gloss: left out
